packageRules.description: Major chart bumps often carry breaking values changes — never automerge, flag loudly
kubectl in utils/Dockerfile tracks the cluster's k3s minor — only patch bumps automatically, minors are bumped by hand together with k3sVersion

SonarQube server, its Community Build number and the community-branch-plugin are version-locked upstream (plugin X.Y.Z only supports Community Build X.Y.Z.*) — they move as one reviewed change, gated behind the dashboard so a server bump can never land ahead of a plugin release
prBodyNotes: - [ ] a [community-branch-plugin](https://github.com/mc1arke/sonarqube-community-branch-plugin/releases) release exists for this Community Build, and its `X.Y.Z` matches `community.buildNumber` in all 5 places (install URL, jar filename, `jvmOpts`, `jvmCeOpts`, webapp zip URL)
- [ ] [sonar-auth-oidc](https://github.com/sonar-auth-oidc/sonar-auth-oidc/releases) still declares this server version as supported
- [ ] [sonar-cnes-report](https://github.com/cnescatlab/sonar-cnes-report/releases) still declares this server version as supported

packageRules.description: SonarQube plugins that version independently of the server — each release pins a supported server range, so read the notes before merging
prBodyNotes: Check the release notes declare the running SonarQube version as supported before merging.

packageRules.description: sonar-auth-oidc tags are `v`-prefixed but its jar filename is not, so the two occurrences extract as separate deps — group them to keep both edits in one PR

customManagers.description: Pinned tool versions in utils/Dockerfile ARGs
k3s version pin (inventory example, real inventory, role default — bumped together)
Gateway API CRD bundle applied by run.sh
Custom ARM64 mattermost image (upstream has no official arm64 build) — tracked independently of the chart's helmv3 bump since the chart's appVersion/digest targets amd64 only

SonarQube Community Build number — the helmv3 bump only moves the chart, the running server version lives in `community.buildNumber` (image tag `<buildNumber>-community`) and is mirrored in our own appVersion
sonarqube-community-branch-plugin — the version appears in the release URL, the jar filename (install list plus both javaagent opts) and the webapp zip URL; all of them must carry the same value
sonar-auth-oidc plugin (project moved from the vaulttec org, which the GitHub API does not redirect)
